author: bamr87
subject: fix(content): improve link health and reduce false positives
body:
Enhanced link checker configuration and fixed broken internal references
to improve site navigation and reduce noise in link health reports.

### Fixed
- Removed /zer0/ bookmark from home.md (404 error)
- Updated quest example navigation from /blog/ to /posts/
- Enhanced link-checker exclusion patterns:
  - Exclude _site/preview/ directory (~15K false positives eliminated)
  - Exclude work/ directory
  - Exclude GitHub blob URLs (rate limited during checks)
  - Exclude Reddit share buttons (rate limited during checks)

### Results
- Total link checks: 152K → 78K (48% reduction in noise)
- Broken links reported: 19,877 → 10,680 (46% reduction)
- Unique broken URLs: 2,173 → 1,696 (22% reduction)
- Focus improved: Eliminated preview build false positives

### Documentation Added
- link-check-results/ANALYSIS_SUMMARY.md - Statistical analysis
- link-check-results/FIXES_APPLIED.md - Detailed fix documentation
- link-check-results/detailed_analysis.md - Automated analysis
- link-check-results/ai_analysis.md - AI-powered insights

### Remaining Issues
- 1,696 unique broken URLs (documented in FIXES_APPLIED.md)
- 353 local dev URLs from theme social buttons (theme fix required)
- External timeouts and rate limits (beyond site control)

See link-check-results/FIXES_APPLIED.md for complete details.
